narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Dependable desktop workspace"**

OpenSeal uses a cool white workspace, soft gray navigation, graphite text, and restrained blue selection. System typography, compact controls, fine separators, and generous content margins express the familiar desktop direction recorded in the surface brief. This is an extraction of the current implementation; the descriptive name below is a documentation label, not a newly approved visual concept.

Scope: the implemented desktop shell, Home, Agents, Work, inspector, command menu, and Settings. PRODUCT.md supplies the durable commitments to clarity, keyboard access, recovery, and truthful capabilities. The surface strategy remains in `.impeccable/surfaces/desktop-src-app-tsx.md`.

The review in `.impeccable/review/finish-verdict.md` accepts the provider form and specified UI fixes within bounded evidence. The comp gate remains open; no approved image comp or explicit code-first preference exists. Proposal activation, live provider execution, and overall desktop completion are not certified. Subsequent parent-reported verification found provider inputs enabled after reopening the updated native binary, and native save/reconnect passed. The subsequent Linux native smoke test also passed actual window closure with owned-daemon exit and reopening with saved provider settings restored and the key hidden. The earlier failure was caused by a close request that required a window manager absent from Xvfb; the corrected test delivers `WM_DELETE_WINDOW` directly. This does not certify macOS or Windows lifecycle behavior. Screenshots `provider-settings.png` and `provider-mobile.png` were inspected for this extraction; native mismatch behavior is source-derived.
keyCharacteristics: Compact controls inside spacious work areas.
Persistent list selection and a contextual inspector.
Semantic color paired with explicit status text.
Light, dark, and system appearance with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Truthful Color Rule
rules.body: Pair state color with an explicit label tied to the current workspace state.

dos: Do preserve the selected row while showing its inspector.
Do keep field labels, retention guidance, and recovery instructions adjacent to the relevant control.
Do use real workspace capabilities and distinguish configured credentials from verified provider access.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and restore focus when dismissing transient UI.
donts: Don't display a saved API key or put it back into an input.
Don't label a refresh as a mutation retry.
Don't imply proposal generation activated an agent.
Don't treat this documentation or the bounded visual acceptance as comp approval or full product completion.
